cases.prompt: Start an Expo React Native app for iOS and Android, using our cloud API and Maestro. Before implementation, inspect package manager, Expo/CNG model, development-build needs, device hosts, tests, and runtime-tool security.
expected_decisions: React Native/Expo and the native-project ownership model are confirmed from repository evidence or marked unknown
Expo Go versus development-build, Maestro, runtime harness, cloud, device, and approval boundaries are recorded before implementation
expected_evidence: package/lockfile, Expo config, EAS, test, Android, and iOS signals are recorded without executing dynamic app config
secret, signing, account, and production values are not copied

cases.prompt: Enable agent-device and possibly Expo MCP for a confidential Expo repository. First map local device control, screenshots/logs/network artifacts, filesystem and network access, Expo account permissions, remote data paths, staging accounts, and forbidden production side effects.
expected_decisions: Framework skills, local runtime tools, and remote account-backed MCP capabilities are treated as separate trust boundaries
One primary device driver and explicit artifact/side-effect policies are selected before runtime use

cases.prompt: The Expo feature changes camera permission behavior. Operate the Android emulator and iOS simulator, record build and device identity, verify explicit allow/deny/retry oracles, capture focused evidence, and decide which Maestro flow should be added.
expected_decisions: The run uses verify mode with explicit platform-specific oracles
Durable coverage is promoted to Maestro without treating screenshots as sufficient proof
expected_evidence: source/build/target/environment identity and Android/iOS results are recorded separately

cases.prompt: Reproduce a React Native deep-link bug that only appears after app process termination. Use a running target, record initial state and operations, collect logs and screenshots, return fail/blocked/inconclusive precisely, then propose the smallest durable regression layer.
expected_decisions: The run uses reproduce mode and does not convert observation into an unsupported pass
Regression promotion selects a canonical layer rather than duplicate .ad and Maestro ownership

cases.prompt: Add and verify a pure TypeScript email-normalization function with focused Jest cases. No component, native API, device, navigation, lifecycle, or runtime target is involved.
expected_decisions: Focused unit tests are sufficient; a device run is not opened

cases.prompt: Verify a presentational React Native component renders its validation message and accessibility role using React Native Testing Library. It has no native/runtime boundary.
expected_decisions: Component evidence remains at the RNTL layer

cases.prompt: Run the repository's already-defined Maestro smoke suite with its documented command and report the existing assertions. Do not explore, debug, profile, or create a runtime record.
expected_decisions: Executing an existing E2E suite alone does not trigger exploratory runtime verification

cases.prompt: Both mobile builds are approved. Coordinate App Store and Play publication, backend compatibility, feature flags, and rollback without operating the app UI.
expected_decisions: Store/release coordination stays in the release gate

cases.prompt: Before claiming this Expo camera feature complete on Android and iOS, gate Jest/RNTL, Maestro, and agent-device evidence. The agent only attached screenshots for iOS and did not record an oracle or build identity.
expected_decisions: Screenshot-only iOS evidence is inconclusive and blocks a both-platform completion claim
Regression, runtime-verification, and observation evidence are classified separately
